verdict: All leads this period came from organic; paid campaigns are paused.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, paid advertising on both Meta and Google ran at zero spend, so every inquiry you received came entirely from your organic presence — primarily your Google Business Profile. That profile delivered 93 actions this period, including 20 calls and 44 website clicks, which is a meaningful baseline, but GBP engagement dropped 40% in the most recent 7 days and has shown no activity in the last three days, making it the one number worth watching closely right now. Instagram reach also pulled back roughly 38% week-over-week, consistent with a content cadence or platform shift. We're addressing the GBP decline and refreshing content output this week to stabilize both channels before the dip compounds.

highlights.phrase: Google Business Profile actions received this period — calls, direction requests, and site clicks — with zero paid support behind them
drop in Google Business Profile engagement over the last 7 days, the primary risk being actively managed
people reached on Instagram this period, though reach declined 38% in the most recent week

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement has fallen 40% in the last 7 days, with three consecutive days of zero activity — a real and confirmed decline, not a data gap.
watch_item.fix: Content and profile activity are being increased this week to rebuild local search visibility before the trend carries into the next period.
